plugins.name: unity
plugins.description: Unity's official game development plugin, ported for ZCode. Build, monetize, and operate Unity games with guidance grounded in Unity's documented practices.

description_i18n.zh-CN: Unity 官方游戏开发插件（ZCode 移植版）。以 Unity 官方文档实践为依据，帮助你开发、变现和运营 Unity 游戏，内含 31 个覆盖 UI、2D/Tilemap、导航、物理、渲染、音频、多人联机、内购变现、本地化与性能优化的技能。
description_i18n.en-US: Unity's official game development plugin, ported for ZCode. Build, monetize, and operate Unity games with guidance grounded in Unity's documented practices.

examplePrompts: Set up a tilemap level with rule tiles for my 2D Unity game.
Help me implement in-app purchases and set up ad mediation with LevelPlay.
Set up multiplayer lobbies and networking for my Unity game.
为我的 2D Unity 游戏搭建带规则瓦片（RuleTile）的关卡。
帮我接入 Unity 内购（IAP），并用 LevelPlay 配置广告聚合。
把我的项目从内置渲染管线迁移到 URP。
